# Official Icon Sources

The vendor icons in this directory are used only to identify the corresponding external system, open source project, or Google Cloud managed service in the ASM+ architecture diagrams.

| Assets | Official source |
|---|---|
| Google Cloud product icons | https://cloud.google.com/icons |
| SAP logo | https://www.sap.com/design-system/digital/foundations/identity/logo/ |
| Kubernetes artwork | https://github.com/cncf/artwork/tree/main/projects/kubernetes |
| Helm artwork | https://github.com/cncf/artwork/tree/main/projects/helm |

Google Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, GKE, and Compute Engine use the current core product artwork downloaded from the official Google Cloud icon library. Other named Google Cloud services use the official legacy product artwork provided by the same library when the current core package does not contain an equivalent product icon.

SAP, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and Helm names and logos remain the property of their respective owners. Their appearance here identifies an integration or deployed technology and does not imply ownership of ASM+ or endorsement of this documentation.
